Residents:
Felix and Aisha work weekdays 8:00-17:30, leaving ~09:00 and returning ~18:00. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Both are home evenings.

Object Locations (Current State, Sat 23:59):
Balcony: gloves, watering can, spray bottle (table).
Bathroom: detergent, laundry basket, Felix razor, toiletry bag (shelf); Aisha razor, soap, toothbrushes (sink); Aisha meds, Felix skincare (cabinet); towels (rack).
Bedroom 1: ironing board (floor); Aisha laptop, Felix charger, Aisha/Felix headphones, Aisha notebook/pen (desk); Felix hair dryer (dresser); Aisha/Felix books, tablets, Aisha glasses (bed); empty wardrobe.
Entry: toolbox, vacuum (floor); Aisha/Felix jackets, scarves, backpacks, Felix laptop, Aisha lunchbox (hook); Aisha/Felix keys, wallets (table); Aisha/Felix shoes (rack).
Kitchen: kettle, toaster, clock, cutting board, pan, spatula (counter); knives (drawer); duster, Aisha/Felix glasses, mugs, bowls, plates, snack bowl, serving dish (cupboard); Aisha/Felix water bottles (dish rack); fruit bowl (table); shopping bag (pantry).
Living: cushions, blanket (couch); board game, picture, speaker, vase (shelf); candle, coasters, tissues, remote (coffee table); lamp (side table).
Office: empty.

Movement Patterns:
- Kitchen items (cutting board, knives, pan, spatula, plates, mugs, bowls) move between counter, sink, cupboard, and table during evening meal prep/cleanup (19:00-23:00).
- Water bottles (Aisha/Felix) appear in entry at 18:00 (arrival), move to kitchen table/dish rack by 21:00.
- Aisha’s personal items (backpack, jacket, keys, wallet, shoes, etc.) appear in entry at 18:00 (arrival) and remain there.
- Aisha’s headphones move entry -> desk (19:00).
- Aisha’s glasses move nightstand -> bed (22:00).
- Felix’s charger moves entry hook -> desk (19:00).
- Phones (Aisha/Felix) appear at 18:00 (coffee table/nightstand), move to nightstand by 21:00, then often "not in any room" (carried) by 22:00-23:00.
- Remote moves TV stand -> coffee table -> couch (21:00-23:00).
- Blanket moves couch -> coffee table -> couch (21:00-23:00).
- Shared kitchen items (serving dish, snack bowl) move cupboard -> table -> cupboard (20:00-22:00).
- Felix’s book/tablet move nightstand -> bed -> nightstand (21:00-23:00).
- Shopping bag moves pantry -> out of house -> pantry (19:00-20:00).
- Morning routine (07:00-09:00): Felix takes tablet, vitamins, phone, charger, headphones, jacket, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle, laptop, backpack. Aisha takes tablet, phone, backpack, jacket, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle, lunchbox, notebook, pen, headphones. Items are "not in any room" (carried out) until 18:00 return.
- Evening routine (19:00-20:00): Felix briefly leaves house (jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, wallet gone) and returns by 19:58.
